_comment: Phase 8.5 tribal-knowledge set. Seeded from a real smoke ingest (see GhostKube_Guide.md Phase 8.5) of kubernetes-sigs/kind via POST /ingest {"url": "https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/kind", "source_type": "pr"}, sampled to the 3 most recently merged PRs (#4214, #4226, #4192) within the default 6-month PR_LOOKBACK_MONTHS window - not the full PR history. These are exactly the queries a code-only index cannot answer: the 'why', not the 'what'. Run against a Chroma index that has actually ingested these PRs (a fresh chroma_db has none of this) - queries_f1.json/queries_meetme.json remain the code-retrieval sets and are untouched by this phase.

query: why did docker client proxy settings stop working on docker nodes
